{{Quote|Surprise is no replacement for firepower.|Heavy Weapons Specialists response to Infiltrator maxim|<ref name="RoE:TRSFH">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>}}
'''Heavy Weapons Specialists''' were a branch of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]]. A combat heavy role, Heavy Weapons Specialists were trained to operate and maintain a wide variety of heavy weapons, including [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]], [[Missile/Legends|missile]] weapons, and [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]]. Brash, loud, and direct, Heavy Weapons Specialists never abandoned their position or abandoned their weapon.

==Organization==
Heavy Weapons Specialists were a military speciality within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]].<ref name="RASB" /> The 6th Regiment of every SpecForce division was comprised of Heavy Weapons Specialists.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> Simply put, Heavy Weapons Specialists operated SpecForce's arsenal of [[heavy weapon]]s, provided other [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] with cover from enemy forces including air and ground vehicles, and gave Alliance forces extra offensive punch during assault on enemy positions and facilities. Heavy Weapons Specialists suffered from a higher casualty rate than any other branch of SpecForce; their training emphasised the need to hold their positions at all costs. Once a Heavy Weapons Specialists position was identified, they became the target of enemy fire. Heavy Weapons Specialists would rather die at their posts than abandon their weapon.<ref name="RASB" /> This mindset led to two types of Heavy Weapons Specialists; veterans and targets. There were no average Heavy Weapons Specialists.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> In addition to their groundside combat duties, Heavy Weapons Specialists stationed with the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] were expected to replace [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] incapacitated in battle.<ref name="RASB" />

==History==
Heavy Weapons Specialists [[Fire team/Legends|fire teams]] were close knit, a result of the reliance each gunner placed on the other members of their unit. They could be employed in a wide variety of terrains, and a wide range of mission profiles, effortlessly reinforcing [[Marines (SpecForce)|Marines]], [[Wilderness Fighters]], and [[Urban Guerrillas/Legends|Urban Guerrillas]] as needed. A Heavy Weapons Specialists unit were never deployed as a single combat unit. The high casualty rate among Heavy Weapons Specialists keep the regiments numbers lower than other regiments. Veteran Heavy Weapons Specialists were held in high regard by their peers.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />

[[Team 19]], a Marine [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] based on the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Mantan Wanderer]]'', had a Heavy Weapons Specialists squad attached to it, under the command of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Whumparrin]].<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />

==Personnel==
[[File:HWS_Spec.jpg|thumb|left|A Heavy Weapons Specialist]]
{{Quote|Primed and ready to fire! Get ready to duck, troops!|Heavy Weapons Specialist|<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />}}
Heavy Weapons Specialists were generally athletic youths, competing in sports and developing their physique and fitness. They were not stupid, however, and saw the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for what it was, joining the Alliance as soon as they were able to. Their years of athletic training and upper body strength led them to a posting in SpecForces Heavy Weapons Specialists; the weapons needed strength to lift. Trained on all types of heavy weapons, from infantry support weapons, to [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]], to [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] guns. Following [[drop camp]], Heavy Weapons Specialists trained on [[Safe world/Legends|safe worlds]] with [[Missile/Legends|missile]] weapons, heavy blasters, and [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]]. Maintenance and repair of weapons were taught, and they were rotated to a line [[Starship/Legends|ship]] for further space weapon training, usually in concert with Marines.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />

Heavy Weapons Specialists were bold, brash, and lacked subtlety in all forms. Their overriding belief was that superior firepower was the solution to all military problems, and they strove to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the enemy before they were killed themselves. Other Specs referred to them as "gunners," or, simply, "HWSs."<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />

Sergeant Whumparrin was a Wookiee Heavy Weapons Specialist, who led a squad assigned to Team 19. A rescued [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], Whumparrin was assigned as a Heavy Weapons Specialists as an act of pragmatism; he could easily carry the weapon. He acquired a fearsome reputation, both among his Alliance brethren and the Empire. A howling Wookiee armed with a [[Medium repeating blaster/Legends|medium repeating blaster]] was a sight that many did not forget.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />

==Skills==
Training for Heavy Weapons Specialists focused almost exclusively on combat and related skills.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> They were trained to handle [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], and operate a wide variety of heavy weapons, including repeating blasters, blaster artillery, vehicle-mounted weapons,<ref name="RASB2">[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> and missile weapons. Maintenance and repair of these weapons was also taught.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> Operation of ship-mounted weapons was a secondary speciality, as Heavy Weapons Specialists were expect to act as reserve Fleet gunners if the need arose. They were also skill in the operation of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]].<ref name="RASB2" /> They were physically fit and strong,<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" /> and were capable brawlers in a fight. Heavy Weapons Specialists were also skilled in basic survival, demolitions training, and first aid techniques.<ref name="RASB2" />

==Equipment==
Each Heavy Weapons Specialist was armed with a heavy weapon, and these weapons usually varied according to the mission profile. A [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]] were carried for closer-in defense, and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] for communication.<ref name="RASB" /> Repeating blasters, infantry support weapons, missile weapons, and other similar weapons could be used by Heavy Weapons Specialists. [[Flame Rifle]]s were also part of the Heavy Weapons Specialists' arsenal, and [[Vehicle Flamer]]s were reserved exclusively for their use. All SpecForce artillery units were also operated by Heavy Weapons Specialists.<ref name="RoE:TRSFH" />
